phase-review.scope: Reconcile the six Phase5 actions explained to the owner against actual implementation, contracts, executable examples and measured consumers. Future runtime extensions remain conditional on demonstrated need; this report does not invent their implementation or redefine the campaign as complete.

item.title: Artifact handling seam
item.finding: Existing text-patch-v2 read/serialize/plan/apply/extract/fingerprint capabilities are behind the engine seam. Only add/modify are advertised; no binary/delete/move capability is claimed.

item.title: Legacy compatibility
item.finding: Actual dirty Nimbus consumer was not edited:43 artifacts/89 hunks serialized byte-exact and planned/applied in memory against pinned Git blobs. This is not its full application build.

item.title: Build command rules
item.finding: Type-neutral argv/cwd/env/network/input/output/restore vocabulary and current Node one-shot/watch compatibility examples. No new recipe reader, non-npm receipt implementation or non-Node successful build is claimed.

item.title: Coordinated component release rules
item.finding: Public state/proof/idempotency/resume/partial-result/compensation contract with nine existing executable examples. Supported XML fences restore six indexed contract units. No production coordinator or durable runtime journal implementation is claimed.

item.title: Orion integration
item.finding: Recovered genuine Theia consumer snapshot79a383a4e33c1d6c4b065445c4d092059b4606ec passes materialization, unchanged save, local delivery, cold CI, offline package and packaged-workbench launch. Descriptor956a287c binds actual output bytes. Licence/carrier edits after that snapshot require fresh distribution evidence; policy/NOTICE/SBOM and legal/signing are separate Phase2 inputs.

item.title: Evidence and deferred extension boundary
item.finding: This review records exact proof scope and content hashes, rather than promoting example vectors or historical build outputs to unimplemented runtime capabilities or actual legal approvals.

phase-review.verification: Latest complete available implementation floor is recorded in the campaign ledger. Coordinator9/9 and recipe compatibility examples are existing cases within that floor; no additional runtime is inferred from their abstract nature.

conditional-extensions.item: Another codec and explicit path migration: only after a real consumer needs unsupported operations or target paths.
Recipe v2 runtime/non-npm receipts: only after a real non-Node execution requirement.
Production coordinator and its crash-recovery storage: only after a real coordinated multi-component release requirement.
Composite checkout graph: only after a measured consumer needs several linked component checkouts.

phase-review.interpretation: Inference from the two recorded consumer measurements: neither currently demonstrates those additional runtime requirements. Their future implementation conditions remain intact, not waived through fixtures or arbitrary simplification.
phase-review.remaining-campaign-work: Continue Phase3 native Windows lifecycle/CLI proof and Phase2 actual owner-backed distribution evidence. Independent third-party adapter integration is outside campaign scope by the owner decision. This Phase5 review alone does not complete the campaign.
